response.sql: WITH telescope_counts AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) as telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), total_telescopes AS (SELECT COUNT(*) as total_count FROM telescopes), shares AS (SELECT tc.observstation, tc.telescope_count, CAST(tc.telescope_count AS FLOAT) / tt.total_count as share FROM telescope_counts tc CROSS JOIN total_telescopes tt), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM shares), filtered_shares AS (SELECT s.observstation, s.telescope_count, s.share, avgs.avg_share FROM shares s CROSS JOIN average_share avgs WHERE s.share > avgs.avg_share) SELECT SUM(telescope_count) as combined_telescopes, AVG(share) as average_share, AVG(share - avg_share) as average_excess FROM filtered_shares
